cases.name: Jessica Marie Diedrick
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "She lived her life helping others as a CNA. She is from Wrightstown, WI, and only recently moved to Kentucky."

Neighbors Clara and Dallas Kelly have lived in the home across the street for decades. Words like “wonderful” and “caring” were used to describe Jessica. They say she looked after others, and even helped another neighbor who needed medical attention last month. “They went over and she was practically in a coma,” Clara said. “Her sugar was so low, so they saved her life.”

Her obituary said, "Jessica was known for her kind heart and infectious smile. She touched the lives of many with her generosity and passion for helping others. She worked as a CNA, assisting the elderly and hospice patients. In her free time, she enjoyed crafting and gardening. Jessica’s biggest love was spending time with her family. Her presence will be deeply missed, but her spirit will live on in the hearts of those who were fortunate enough to know her."
cases.relationship: Brother / stepbrother / partner or sibling's brother / brother-in-law
cases.narrative: (Her husband) David recalls Jessica woke him up to the sound of glass breaking and kicking the door and he went to go check. In the commotion, he ran outside through the basement door of the house thinking Jessica was in front of him. He says that’s when he heard gunshots. “She didn’t make it out," David said. “She went back to get clothes on, and that little split second cost her.” He thinks Ramhlow broke in looking for his sister who had been with the couple earlier.
